# Lane 2.224 — the two-league test sees the code's own fence (D-M1)

Builder's note, 2026-11-23. Branch `lane/2.224-fence-test`. No query, store or migration changed.

## Built

- **Arrange inside the target's own fence** (`isolation-registry/-harness.test-helper.ts`): a case's `arrange` runs before every run, as the app role with the database set to league B and B's owner (rows' triggers held, since `updated_at` reads the real clock); each run is judged against the database as arranged, read once per case.
- **Cases arranged:** every public read that opened B's season and both read stores; postponed games (query, command); games needing a result and earlier rounds; the bin (list, purge, restores, binned game parts: one of each kind in B's bin plus a court, team and person nothing points at, fixed ids); the draft insert (B's draft discarded first); "the league's own" reads (`findCurrentLeague`, `findLeagueAudience`, `findLeagueTimeZone`, `findLeagueToday`, `leagueDayOf`, and the roster's audience read: B set to another time zone and audience, A's row moved after B's). `find-public-team` asks by the seed's short name (`LeagueRecords.teamSlug`).
- **Fixed SQL clock:** `now()` in a query answers `harnessNow` (a `harness_clock.now()` searched first), set before seeding. The seeded support visit keeps the real clock (a database trigger starts it).
- **Standing check:** `node scripts/fence-filter-check.mjs [files] | --list | --excused`: each filter out in turn, the file's own groups must fail; cases must pass as written first; file restored and re-read. `tests/fence-filter-check.test.mjs` (in `npm test`) holds the excused list to 4 and the 12 gaps in reach.

## What the test found

- **No leak in the product.** With every filter in place all 297 groups pass in all five runs; every failure seen came from a filter taken out on purpose. Nothing to cure in `packages/database`.
- **All 12 of the audit's confirmed gaps are now caught** with their filter out: list-public-roster#2, find-public-team, list-public-games, find-public-season, find-public-game-facts, list-public-teams, list-postponed-games, list-binned#1 (and #2 to #6), purge-binned#2 (venues, and #1, #7, #8), restore-binned-game, has-binned-game-part, insert-schedule-draft#1 (and #2). Also caught: restore-binned-person, list-season-stat-keys, list-public-seasons.

## Left

- Still survive (not excused): list-public-roster#1 (audience read: B's other audience does not change A's minor's line), list-games-in-window#1, games-for-lists#2-#5, list-earlier-rounds#1-#3, list-season-teams#1-#3, list-public-schedule#1. Mostly a second filter in the same statement (audit 1b): excuse with reasons, or give cases that see one filter alone.
- Whole sweep not run: 25 of 187 files. 48 files have no filter of a shape the check knows (eb(...) inside and/or, inserts, league via another query): printed "not checked". Command cases (`registerCommandCase`) have no arrange yet.
- Not reached: has-recorded-child, update-game-not-started, list-refused-adds, change-table-player, remove-table-player, the statements no case reaches (audit 1b).
- Branch not merged with the build branch since it was cut.

## Decisions

- Record 096 / T-294 (numbers from the lead's old brief), **Agreed (delegated)**, pending the lead: per-case arrange rather than a changed seed; triggers held during arrange; the standing check NOT in `npm run verify` (one test process per filter, ~8 s, 215 filters: 30-45 min). Recommended: GitHub's check alone or nightly; the lead decides.

## Checks

`npm run check` pass; `npm run typecheck` pass; prettier on changed files pass; `isolation-cases.test.ts` 297/297; `node --test tests/fence-filter-check.test.mjs` 2/2; `npx vitest run packages/database apps/web/src/server/database-event-handlers.test.ts` 143 files, 1627 tests pass. `npm run verify` not run (builder rule).
